about:
ITW Food Equipment Group is headquartered in Troy, Ohio. The group traces its roots to 1830 with the founding of Bonnet in Europe and brings together brands such as Hobart (120 years), Vulcan (150 years), Baxter (50-plus years), Traulsen, Foster, Wolf, and Stero. The company operates as a family of premium brands dedicated to commercial food equipment.

The group designs, manufactures, and services a broad range of commercial food equipment including cooking, refrigeration, warewashing, and bakery systems. Its brands collectively offer nearly 600 ENERGY STAR certified products. Hobart maintains nearly 200 offices and 1,500 factory-trained service technicians, covering 95% of service customers within 50 miles. Innovation is central: more than 1,000 staff members hold at least one invention, and in 2013 over 70% of ITW patent applications were commercialized. Key technologies include the Advansys energy recovery system for dishwashers, finless condenser coils in refrigeration, infrared cooking in charbroilers and griddles, and the SmartConnect365 remote monitoring platform.

ITW Food Equipment serves the foodservice, food retail, bakery, restaurant, hotel, school, rest-home catering, and broader catering equipment markets worldwide. Customers range from independent restaurants to large institutional kitchens and food retail operations.

The company emphasizes customer-driven innovation, sustainable leadership, and local service depth. It has earned the EPA ENERGY STAR Partner of the Year award every year since 2008, receiving the Sustained Excellence Award in 2024. Foster attained the Carbon Trust Standard for carbon reduction. The group’s differentiation rests on its extensive service network, high rate of patent commercialization, and energy- and water-saving equipment technologies.

name: IWG High Performance Conductors
old_description: International Wire Cable Services offers a comprehensive range of wire products, including bare and tinned copper wires, as well as tinned and stainless steel braids, tailored to meet diverse industry needs.
about:
International Wire, headquartered in Camden, New York, traces its origins to 1885. The company has grown through strategic acquisitions to become the largest non-vertically integrated manufacturer of copper and copper-alloy wire products in the United States, serving customers across the U.S. and Europe.

The company produces a comprehensive range of wire products including single-end wire (44 AWG to 2 AWG), stranded wire, braided wire, copper wire on bobbins, and flat wire. Its manufacturing capabilities encompass drawing, stranding, bunching, bobbin winding, braiding, cable over-braiding, and custom harness braiding. With thousands of product variations, International Wire operates at a scale that supports both standard and custom requirements for diverse applications.

Its customer base spans advanced manufacturing and automation, electrification and power infrastructure (solar farms, wind turbines, nuclear energy), aerospace and defense systems (in-flight entertainment, cabin management, airframe wiring), data centers and critical connectivity, transportation and e-mobility (electric vehicles), smart living and appliances, energy extraction and processing (oil and gas), healthcare and medical devices, and built environment and infrastructure. The company works with manufacturers, contractors, and specifiers in these sectors.

International Wire differentiates itself through decades of experience in wire drawing, conductor fabrication, and custom wire solutions, combining proven material science with manufacturing scalability and tailored support. Its stated mission is to deliver value-driven, high-quality wire products and services that exceed client expectations.

name: Icon Metals Machining & Fabrication
old_description: From custom fabrication to CNC machining, Icon Metals delivers superior quality and exceptional service for all your metal manufacturing needs.
about:
Icon Metals Machining & Fabrication operates from Freedom, Wisconsin, where it was founded in 2016. The business began as Mike's Welding before rebranding to its current name, carrying forward a tradition of metalworking craftsmanship.

The shop provides CNC machining, fabrication, tube laser cutting, structural steel fabrication, gear and sprocket hobbing, and tube bending. Its equipment includes a BLM LT8 tube laser capable of 8-inch square or 23 lbs/ft, a Hurco VM2 CNC mill, a Kia Super Turn 21 CNC lathe, and a Dianichi F250 CNC lathe. With 13 employees, the company reports more than 15,000 projects completed.

Icon Metals serves customers needing precision metal fabrication and machining services, though specific industry sectors or named clients are not disclosed in its public materials.

The company states its goal is to exceed customer expectations on welding, fabrication, tube laser/bending, and machining services, positioning itself as a partner with exceptional customer service.

name: Icon Modern
old_description: + years in custom fabrication, we have learned how to make custom products more accessible to designers by creating a streamlined, easy process and offering a wider range of materials and capabilities than most custom shops. The majority of our materials are sourced locally and we fabricate everything in our hometown of Chicago.
about:
Icon Modern was founded in 2007 by Rocky Levy and Aaron Tvrdy in Chicago, Illinois. The founders, who met through a shared passion for sustainable design, started in a garage and quickly secured projects with national brands such as Starbucks, Whole Foods, and Twitter.

The company produces commercial furniture and architectural elements — conference tables, community tables, reception desks, space dividers, ceiling elements, feature walls, planters, and countertops — using a broad range of materials including urban hardwoods, steel, stone, glass, and veneers. In-house capabilities span CNC machining, metal fabrication and welding, woodworking, powder coating, stone and glass fabrication, as well as engineering, value engineering, 3D rendering, shop drawings, and prototyping. Icon Modern imposes no minimum or maximum order quantities and emphasizes shorter lead times through a streamlined process.

The firm serves architects, interior designers, and corporate clients across hospitality, retail, technology, and corporate office sectors. Notable projects include installations for Caterpillar, Jump Trading, and IPG, alongside the earlier brand-name work. A dedicated project manager oversees each job from concept through installation, handling engineering, detailing, and logistics on the client's behalf.

Icon Modern's founding mission centers on sustainability and creative reuse: sourcing all materials within a 100-mile radius of its Chicago shop and giving urban trees a second life as furniture. The team, which includes architects and designers, aims to make custom fabrication more accessible to designers by offering a wider material palette and a collaborative, end-to-end service that eliminates the need for clients to coordinate multiple vendors.

name: Icon Solar
old_description: Icon Solar is the leading provider of solar panel installation in
about:
Icon Solar was founded in 2009 in Milford, Ohio, and has grown into a regional solar installation company serving Ohio, Kentucky, and Indiana. The company operates as a locally owned installer without outside subcontractors, handling every project directly from design through grid connection.

The firm provides turnkey residential and commercial solar installations, including system design, permitting, panel mounting, inverter and battery storage integration, and utility interconnection. It partners with manufacturers such as Franklin WH Home Battery, Enphase Ensemble, and Tesla Powerwall to supply equipment, and emphasizes premium components like black-on-black solar panels and module-level power electronics. Icon Solar describes itself as one of the largest residential installers in the tri-state area, though it does not disclose facility size or headcount.

The company also works with municipal solar programs and the 'Find It Duke' referral network. Projects range from rooftop arrays for single-family homes to commercial systems aimed at reducing overhead energy costs.

Icon Solar differentiates itself by refusing to subcontract work, maintaining direct manufacturer relationships, and offering 25-year production warranties on both panels and inverters. It cites an A+ Better Business Bureau rating with zero complaints, a 4.8 Google review score, and a typical installation timeline of about six weeks from permit to grid connection as evidence of its reliability.

Idaho Livin was founded in 2017 in Boise, Idaho. The company operates from the Clearwater Building in downtown Boise, where it maintains a retail storefront open seven days a week. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs, prints, and sells a range of apparel including graphic tees, fleece shorts, hats, and hoodies. All products are described as designed and printed in Idaho. The operation fulfills online orders with next-business-day shipping from Boise and serves over 17,000 customers since launch. It also offers custom apparel services for businesses and organizations.

Idaho Livin serves both direct consumers through its retail and e-commerce channels and business clients seeking custom branded apparel. Its product line leans toward outdoor and lifestyle themes, with designs referencing Idaho landmarks such as the Sawtooth Mountains and the City of Trees.

The brand emphasizes local production and quick turnaround, promoting that every hat, tee, and hoodie is designed and printed in Idaho and that stocked items ship the next business day.

name: Idaho Sewing For Sports, LLC
old_description: Since 1995 we have used your tubes and had great success. Long-lasting, and you have always delivered on time. Thanks for making everything in the USA.
about:
Founded in 1974 in Grangeville, Idaho, Idaho Sewing for Sports began as a small local business sewing truck seats. Co-founders Will and Gail Williams identified a need for quality padding in the ski industry over 40 years ago. The company is woman-owned and operates as an Idaho-based U.S. manufacturer.

The company designs and manufactures custom safety padding for ski areas, gyms, and sports venues across North America. Production takes place at their Idaho facility where a team of skilled craftsmen and designers produces thousands of pads annually. They use heavy-duty UV-resistant vinyl, high-density foam, and closed-cell foam, with capabilities including custom sewing, made-to-order sizing, custom colors and logos, and sustainable recyclable options introduced in 2022.

Idaho Sewing serves ski areas (600+ worldwide), athletic facilities (schools, rec centers, stadiums), playgrounds and parks, adventure parks, climbing gyms, ropes courses, and amusement parks. Customers include ski resorts such as Brooks Lake Lodge and Four Seasons Ski Center, which have used their tubing products since 1995.

The company emphasizes personal customer service, with padding experts guiding clients from quote through design, manufacturing, and delivery. Their differentiation includes nearly 50 years of expertise, all-weather materials, custom-fit solutions, and pioneering the industry's first 100% recyclable padding. They are a member of the National Ski Areas Association.

name: Idaho Supreme Potatoes Inc.
old_description: Idaho Pacific Holdings, Inc. is a family of potato dehydration companies spanning North America – from the nutrient rich farmlands of Idaho to the San Luis Valley of Colorado to the red sandy soils of Prince Edward Island, Canada.
about:
Idaho Supreme Potatoes operates in Firth, Idaho, where it began as a fresh potato packing operation in 1967. The facility added dehydration capacity in 1969 and grew into one of North America's potato dehydration plants. In 2018, Idaho Pacific Holdings acquired the company and continues its tradition of supplying dehydrated potato products worldwide.

The plant produces dehydrated potato flakes, flour, slices, dices, and shreds/hash browns, with ingredient specifications ranging from whole flake to finely milled flour, full-cook to low-leach, and additive-free clean-label options. Foodservice lines include blended or agglomerated mashed potato mixes, scalloped and au gratin casseroles, and seasoned or unseasoned hash browns. An in-house R&D team develops custom formulations. Packaging runs from poly pouches, gabled cartons, and #10 tins to kraft bags, bulk sacks, and bulk rail or truck loads, with private-label options for foodservice and retail.

Customers span foodservice distributors, retail brands, and industrial food manufacturers seeking potato ingredients for prepared meals, snacks, and bakery applications. The facility sources Russet varieties such as Burbank, Norkotah, and Ranger from Idaho's Snake River Plain.

The operation highlights its diverse production capabilities, custom specification development, private-label packaging, bulk rail and truck logistics, and certifications under a GFSI-benchmarked standard, Kosher (OU), and Halal (IFANCA).
